lane:
اه

أَهَّ 1 , (S in art. اوه, and K,) inf. n. أَةٌّ (K) and أَهَّةٌ (S, * K) and the same without teshdeed; (K, * TA; [app. meaning آهَةٌ, which, however, belongs to art. اوه, q. v.;]) or إِهَّةٌ; (so in the CK; [but in some copies of the K, and ↓أَهَّهَ, as in the TK, where it is said that the inf. n. of this form of the verb is تَأْهِيهٌ;]) and ↓تأهّه; (K;) [_i. q._ آهَ _and_ أَوَّهَ _and_ تَأَهِيهٌ; or] _He expressed pain_ or _grief_ or _sorrow,_ or _he lamented_ or _complained_ or _moaned,_ (S, K,) _as one in an evil state, and broken in spirit by grief_ or _mourning, and said_ آهِ, or هَاهْ. (K.) [See a verse cited in art. اوه, voce آهَةٌ.]

اهه اَهَّهَ 2 and 5: see above.

إِهْ , i. e. إِ with the ه of pausation; imperative of وَأَي, q. v. (Mughnee in art. الف)

آه آهِ and آهٍ and آهًا &c.: see art. اوه.
